text.tspan: Application Load Balancer: listener → rules → target group → healthy targets in 2+ AZs
ALB: L7 HTTP/HTTPS, host/path routing, WAF, gRPC
NLB: L4 TCP/UDP/TLS, static IPs, millions of rps, low latency
Algorithms: round robin (default), least outstanding requests
502: target sent a bad/closed response (crash, reset)
503: no registered targets in the target group
504: target too slow (> idle timeout, default 60 s)
ALB fails open: if ALL targets are unhealthy, it sends to all
